messages:
alyssa_csm: Quick sync 1: web4re kicking off the quiet beta with 3 customers, 8 seats total. Need final seat owners and survey timing.

maria_success: I set up PulseCo (5 seats), Emberly (2), NovaArk (1). Sent invites; PulseCo SSO pending with their IdP.

noah_ops: Confirmed SSO ticket with PulseCo, Okta side ETA ~48h. I can create temp invites if we want them to start earlier.

alyssa_csm: Temp invites for PulseCo please. Do not send week1 survey to PulseCo until SSO completes. Emberly and NovaArk should get survey MON 09:00 PT.

josh_product: Please enable beta_prompt_eval telemetry for these orgs before survey so we can link responses to prompt performance.

sam_eng: Done in staging and deploying to prod now. CLI I ran:
```
redwoodctl flags set beta_prompt_eval --orgs pulseco,emberly,novaark
```
Rolling in 7m.

maria_success: Emberly accepted invites already. PulseCo temp invites posted: https://redwood.app/invite/pulse-temp123

survey-bot: Survey scheduled: https://survey.app/quiet-beta-week1 - default send MON 09:00 PT to Emberly,NovaArk. PulseCo excluded. Results -> #beta-ops.

alyssa_csm: Two asks: 1) include 3 starter prompts + short playbook link in invite email; 2) tag orgs with "quiet-beta" for routing/metering.

josh_product: Playbook here: https://docs.redwood.com/quiet-beta-playbook. I uploaded starter prompts under Examples.

noah_ops: Tagged all three orgs with quiet-beta label and set routing policy to small dedicated pool for the cohort.

maria_success: Emberly left early feedback: "great latency, one prompt embedding drift" 1 captured in Emberly feedback doc: https://notion.redwood.com/quiet-beta/emberly-feedback

alyssa_csm: I'll attach that doc to the survey and include an optional open text Q asking for any prompt regressions.

sam_eng: I'll drop a 1-page runbook for manual invite + SSO retry into #beta-ops by EOD.

alyssa_csm: Thanks all  I'll post a final send confirmation in 12h and include counts.
